description: Plan one section from the project's evidence, then have an independent checker review the plan (WTF-P's plan-section playbook).

inputs.name: section
inputs.description: The section to plan, as the outline names it (for example background)

steps.input: Create one contained, immutable plan for section {section} from the portable project state. Write only the plan artifact under .planning/sections/{section}/plans/. $task
Independently check the plan for section {section}: traceability, support for every claim, and fit to the outline and venue. Do not change it. The planner reported: $plan
